security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU continues to gate CSR accessibility or extension enablement on the now-removed 'Smaiae' extension (e.g., Smaclic/Ssaclic/Smnip still requiring Smaiae in an extension dependency table), OR QEMU continues to expose 'Smaiae' in the ISA string or misa extension bitmap when the spec has deleted it, causing guest kernels to make incorrect assumptions about available AIA features (especially xvip/xvien/xviph/xvienh behavior previously mandated as read-only zero under Smaiae)
security_spec.summary: PR removes Smaiae (AIA-for-embedded); Smaclic/Ssaclic/Smnip now depend directly on Smaia/Ssaia — QEMU must update its extension dependency logic to drop Smaiae gating, remove Smaiae from ISA strings, and ensure xvip/xvien WARL behavior reflects full Smaia/Ssaia semantics rather than the deleted Smaiae read-only-zero constraint

findings.finding: CSR access gate correctly uses ext_smaia (the current M-mode AIA extension flag), not the removed Smaiae extension.
32-bit AIA CSR access gate correctly uses ext_smaia.
Indirect CSR or AIA access gate correctly uses ext_smaia (not Smaiae).
S-mode AIA access gate correctly uses ext_ssaia.
xireg access gate correctly dispatches on ext_smaia (M-mode) and ext_ssaia (S-mode). No Smaiae reference.
AIA presence check correctly tests ext_smaia || ext_ssaia.
ISA string table has only 'smaia' and 'ssaia' entries. No 'smaiae' entry exists.
findings.snippet:
ISA_EXT_DATA_ENTRY(smaia, PRIV_VERSION_1_12_0, ext_smaia),
ISA_EXT_DATA_ENTRY(ssaia, PRIV_VERSION_1_12_0, ext_ssaia),

findings.finding: QOM property registration has only 'smaia' and 'ssaia' boolean properties.
findings.snippet:
MULTI_EXT_CFG_BOOL("smaia", ext_smaia, false),
MULTI_EXT_CFG_BOOL("ssaia", ext_ssaia, false),

findings.finding: Extension boolean fields are ext_smaia and ext_ssaia only. No ext_smaiae field.
Max CPU features correctly enable ext_smaia and ext_ssaia, not a removed Smaiae.
AIA IMSIC interrupt delivery correctly checks ext_smaia for M-mode and ext_ssaia for S-mode external interrupts.
KVM extension mapping has only 'ssaia' mapped to KVM_RISCV_ISA_EXT_SSAIA. No Smaiae KVM mapping.
TCG extension validation function contains no Smaiae dependency checks. AIA extensions (smaia/ssaia) are validated without reference to any removed extension.
findings.snippet: (no smaia/ssaia checks in this function — only AIA-related validation is for smcdeleg)

findings.finding: No AIA migration state structures reference Smaiae. AIA state is managed through ireg callbacks, not through an extension-specific vmstate.
findings.snippet: (no smaia/ssaia/smaiae migration state in this file)

findings.finding: mstateenh write-mask for AIA+IMSIC bits correctly gated on ext_smaia, not Smaiae.
